section: Iterate — change: changelog skill prose writes no run state; tag push in the CLI
title: release.py push-tag decides and pushes the release tag
context: P5 of the changelog pilot: the skill prose still named update-step and left the tag-push branching (F1a, F1b, F4) to the model; the P4 review asked for it in code.
decision: SKILL.md names no run-state writer; release.py push-tag reads the run state and pushes only the tag from a feature branch, after the merge for a hand-invoked release, trunk plus tag on main/develop.
consequences: The release guard hook cannot see a push made inside the CLI, so push-tag repeats its record and event-only rules. Two reviewers prefer a decide-only subcommand with a literal push; operator decides at stop 3 (FINDINGS D39, D43).
rationale: A branch on branch kind, mode and merge state is a git question, so it is testable code; the model keeps gh pr create, gh pr merge and the release page.
rejected: Decide-only subcommand with a literal push line (keeps the hook as sole enforcer); leaving the branching as prose.
